#DROP TABLE IF EXISTS s_cmi_summary_mdc;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `s_cmi_summary_mdc` (
	`id` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	`hospcode` VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL,
	`areacode` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
	`flag_sent` VARCHAR(1)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`date_com` VARCHAR(17)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`b_year` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,
	`region` VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
	`chwcode` VARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
	`mdcx` VARCHAR(2) DEFAULT NULL,
	`drgname` VARCHAR(80)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`nopop` int(2)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumcase` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjrw` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`splevel` VARCHAR(2)  DEFAULT NULL ,
	`cntm10` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm10` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm11` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm11` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm12` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm12` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm01` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm01` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm02` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm02` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm03` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm03` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm04` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm04` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm05` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm05` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm06` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm06` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm07` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm07` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm08` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm08` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntm09` int(11)  DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjm09` DOUBLE  DEFAULT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,b_year,mdcx,nopop)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_cmi_summary_mdc WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_cmi_summary_mdc
(id, hospcode, areacode, flag_sent, date_com, b_year, region, chwcode
, mdcx, drgname, nopop, sumcase, sumadjrw, splevel
, cntm10, sumadjm10, cntm11, sumadjm11, cntm12, sumadjm12, cntm01, sumadjm01, cntm02, sumadjm02, cntm03, sumadjm03
, cntm04, sumadjm04, cntm05, sumadjm05, cntm06, sumadjm06, cntm07, sumadjm07, cntm08, sumadjm08, cntm09, sumadjm09)
select @id as id, t.hospcode
, concat(h.provcode, h.distcode, h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
, @send as flag_sent, DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as date_com, @b_year+543 as b_year
, t.region, t.chwcode
, left(t.drg,2) as mdcx, m.drgname, substring(t.drg,3,2) as nopop
, sum(t.cntan) as sumcase, ROUND(sum(t.sumadj),4) as sumadjrw, t.splevel
, sum(t.cntm10) as cntm10, ROUND(sum(t.adjm10),4) as sumadjm10
, sum(t.cntm11) as cntm11, ROUND(sum(t.adjm11),4) as sumadjm11
, sum(t.cntm12) as cntm12, ROUND(sum(t.adjm12),4) as sumadjm12
, sum(t.cntm01) as cntm01, ROUND(sum(t.adjm01),4) as sumadjm01
, sum(t.cntm02) as cntm02, ROUND(sum(t.adjm02),4) as sumadjm02
, sum(t.cntm03) as cntm03, ROUND(sum(t.adjm03),4) as sumadjm03
, sum(t.cntm04) as cntm04, ROUND(sum(t.adjm04),4) as sumadjm04
, sum(t.cntm05) as cntm05, ROUND(sum(t.adjm05),4) as sumadjm05
, sum(t.cntm06) as cntm06, ROUND(sum(t.adjm06),4) as sumadjm06
, sum(t.cntm07) as cntm07, ROUND(sum(t.adjm07),4) as sumadjm07
, sum(t.cntm08) as cntm08, ROUND(sum(t.adjm08),4) as sumadjm08
, sum(t.cntm09) as cntm09, ROUND(sum(t.adjm09),4) as sumadjm09
from t_cmi_admission t join chospital h on t.hospcode = h.hoscode
join ccmimdc m on left(t.drg,2) = m.mdc
GROUP BY t.hospcode, m.mdc, nopop;

SELECT mdcx, drgname,concat(mdcx,' ',drgname) groupname
	,sum(sumcase) as sumall, sum(sumadjrw) as sumadjall
        ,sum(sumadjrw)/sum(sumcase) as p
        ,sum(if(nopop < 50,sumcase,null)) as sumop
        ,sum(if(nopop < 50,sumadjrw,null)) as sumopadj
        ,sum(if(nopop > 49,sumcase,null)) as sumnonop
        ,sum(if(nopop > 49,sumadjrw,null)) as sumnonopadj
FROM {tablename} {sjoin}
WHERE id='{reportid}' AND b_year = '{year}' {where} {hospcode} {DEP} {cmihospcode}
GROUP BY mdcx
